title: LegalMetrixRuleDefinition
description: Schema for deterministic legal metrology rule definitions per category

category.description: Product category identifier (e.g. food, beverage, personal_care, household)

version.description: Version of this category rule definition set

description.description: Optional category description or scope notice

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for the legal rule (e.g. LMR-FOOD-001)

category.description: Product category matching the parent definition

field.description: Key of the extracted field to evaluate (e.g. mrp, net_quantity)

required.description: Whether this declaration is mandatory for the category

expected_value.description: Expected exact value for exact validation

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for pattern validation

min_value.description: Minimum numeric value for numeric or range validation

max_value.description: Maximum numeric value for numeric or range validation
